summary:
All three tasks are done and every gate passes. None of the nine reviewer items was rejected; all were real and are fixed in `src/core/types.ts`, with core, stubs and tools brought in line.

**1. Failing input test.** The test was wrong, not `src/core/input.ts`. The sign convention holds (mouse right = negative yaw, cursor resting at the left edge = positive yaw). The test helper called `endFrame()` after the mouse event, which wiped the mouse delta, so only the edge turn was left. The helper now models core's order (endFrame, browser events, poll). `src/core/input.test.ts` now has 30 tests covering every input fix from the reviews; seven deliberate mutations of `input.ts` were tried and six made a test fail (the seventh did not change behaviour). I also added `src/core/game.test.ts` (18 tests) for the frame pipeline and error containment, since neither had a unit test before the freeze; it found no bugs in `game.ts`.

**2. Reviewer items.**
- **Death sounds cut by the owner rule (both reports):** one-shots that must outlive the entity (every `<type>Death`, the conductor death sounds, anything started in `onKilled` / `updateDying` or right before a self-kill, impact sounds) carry no `owner`. Stated in the header, `EnemyKindSoundId`, `onKilled`, `SoundOptions.owner`, life-cycle step 6 and the combat doc. The placeholder kind now plays its death sound that way as an example.
- **Player dying during the staged boss death:** the first of `player:died` / `boss:defeated` decides the run and both set phase `done`. The player absorbs every hit from `boss:defeated` until the next `reset()`. In `onKilled`, `info.weapon === 'world'` means "removed": play the death, deal no damage; a tick calls `combat.explode` before `enemies.kill`. An actor killed while arriving gets no `onKilled`.
- **`EnemyKillOptions.creditPlayer`:** deleted. `kill()` is always a world kill; nothing used the option.
- **Silently removed boss:** the director's new boss watchdog treats it as defeated with `sequenceSeconds` 0.
- **UI double actions:** vertical arrows no longer change a slider's value, and every screen has an activation guard in its click handlers (0.3 s; perk cards use `PERK_INPUT_GUARD_SECONDS` from `perkOfferedAt`).
- **Cinematic cameras:** `CinematicShot` now defines shots, cuts, a one-key hold and the exact curve. `bossArena` obliges the world to keep the victory orbit ring clear.
- **`reduceFlashes` in every harness run:** `createSettings(storage, events, testMode)` ignores the OS preference in test mode. `tools/shots.mjs` runs its desktop tour on the `high` preset.
- **`screenFlash` callers:** only combat and the conductor's white-outs; lightning uses `lightningFlash` only.

**Where I departed from the reviewers' wording:**
- `boss:defeated` is now emitted before the cleanup kills (previously after), so the player is protected before any add's `onKilled` runs. The cleanup stagger is specified on `ctx.time.playerDt`.
- The vertical-arrow fix lives in `core/input.ts` rather than in a UI keydown listener, so the UI team cannot get it wrong.
- The cinematic curve is defined as `THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, closed, 'centripetal')` with `getPoint((i + u) / segments)`, instead of "clamped end tangents", so world and render compute the identical curve.

**3. Gates.** Typecheck clean, 187 of 187 unit tests, build ok, smoke 48 of 48, sandboxed-embed smoke 17 of 17, campaign reaches victory, screenshot tour ok. `tools/smoke.mjs` gained seven checks: the boss end-of-run rules, the watchdog, and the `reduceFlashes` behaviour inside and outside test mode.

gates.unitTests: PASS: `npx vitest run` 187 of 187 tests in 5 files (core/game.test.ts 18, core/input.test.ts 30, core/foundation.test.ts 14, nav/nav.test.ts 50, physics/collision.test.ts 75).
gates.build: PASS: `npm run build` exit 0 (tsc --noEmit + vite build, 45 modules; dist/assets/game.js 665.88 kB, gzip 185.89 kB).
gates.smoke: PASS: `node tools/smoke.mjs --mode dist` exit 0, 48 of 48 checks, no game or console errors. `node tools/smoke.mjs --mode dist --embed sandbox` exit 0, 17 of 17 checks. Screenshot tour `node tools/shots.mjs --mode dist --out <scratchpad>/foundation/shots` exit 0, 22 PNGs, no errors, victory reached through the real boss path; viewed 01-menu, 02-gameplay-deck-dusk, 17-perk-select and 20-victory, all render. Tour notes only say the gray-box UI has no difficulty / settings / controls screens and no touch controls yet.
gates.campaign: PASS: `node tools/campaign.mjs --mode dist --god 1` exit 0. The bot reaches victory after 498 simulated seconds, all 10 waves, 0 assists, 0 NaN frames, no errors (score 218675, 248 kills, grade S).

openIssues: No reviewer item was rejected. Three were resolved differently from the proposed wording: `EnemyKillOptions.creditPlayer` was deleted rather than redefined; the vertical-arrow rule lives in core/input.ts rather than in a UI keydown listener; the cinematic curve is specified through THREE.CatmullRomCurve3 (mirrored end points) rather than 'clamped end tangents'.

Behaviour change beyond the review list: 'boss:defeated' is now emitted BEFORE the cleanup kills of the adds (it was after), and the 0.6 s cleanup stagger runs on ctx.time.playerDt. The enemies-core engineer must follow life-cycle step 5 in that order.

Design consequence of the world-kill rule: a tick removed by a hazard, the bounds cull, the straggler watchdog or the boss-death cleanup does not explode. Only ticks killed by a real hit, or detonating themselves (explode first, then kill), do.
No automated check can catch an owner-bound death sound: the audio stub is silent. Reviewers of the seven enemy kinds should grep onKilled / updateDying for `owner: actor.id` on one-shot sounds.

Gray-box stubs that are deliberately simpler than the contract: the enemy manager stub removes the adds immediately on boss death instead of staggering them; the render stub has no menu spline, cuts or victory orbit; the UI stub has the activation guard but no focus model; the world stub has no vitest for the camera tube or the victory orbit ring. The real teams own these.

The new smoke checks around the boss must keep passing with the real systems. They use `ctx.enemies.kill(bossId)` with freezeAi on, `damagePlayer(100000)` after 'boss:defeated', and `kill(bossId, { silent: true })` for the watchdog.

Debug quirk: a boss spawned through window.__SH outside the director's 'boss' phase and killed non-silently still emits 'boss:defeated', so the player stays invulnerable until the next reset while the run continues. Tools should remove debug bosses with killAll(true), as tools/shots.mjs does. Conversely, killAll(true) during the director's 'boss' phase triggers the watchdog and ends the run in victory.

Harness facts: test-mode runs have reduceFlashes false; the sandboxed smoke (not test mode, browser asked for reduced motion) has it true. tools/shots.mjs forces 'high' on the desktop tour through render.setQuality (not persisted); the touch tour keeps what 'auto' resolves to.

Not verified: pointer lock with a real mouse (headless Chromium only; the free-look fallback and the lock bookkeeping are covered by unit tests and the sandbox smoke), and real gamepads (fake pad in unit tests only).

docs/production/STATUS.md and docs/production/assign/*.md were not touched. STATUS.md still describes the earlier checkpoint (80 of 81 tests). The assignment texts were not re-synced with these contract edits; types.ts wins where they differ.
